snippet.title: Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble | Pre-Registration Open Now!
snippet.description:
🚨 Brace yourselves, Rangers! Pre-registration is officially LIVE on Google Play and the App Store for Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble!

🎁 The more pre-registrations, the more rewards for everyone at Global Launch. Go get that Clank Suit Widget Skin!

🎟️ Pre-register now: https://bit.ly/RCRR_Pre_Reg

🔔 Subscribe to stay updated: @RangerRumble 

📌 Follow for updates:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RangerRumble
X: https://x.com/RCRangerRumble
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rangerrumble/
Tik-Tok: https://www.tiktok.com/@rangerrumble
